def test_filter_actions_mute(session, signal, project):
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
    from dispatch.signal.models import SignalFilterAction
    from dispatch.signal.service import filter_signal
    from tests.factories import SignalInstanceFactory, SignalFilterFactory

    signal_filter = SignalFilterFactory(
        name="snooze-muted",
        description="test",
        expression=[],
        action="snooze",
        expiration=datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(minutes=5),
        project=project,
    )
    signal.filters = [signal_filter]
    signal.muted_until = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None) + timedelta(minutes=5)

    signal_instance = SignalInstanceFactory(
        project=project, signal=signal, raw=json.dumps({"id": "foo"})
    )
    session.add(signal_instance)
    session.commit()

    assert filter_signal(db_session=session, signal_instance=signal_instance)
